name: Horror: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Horror look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, horror film still, subject half lost in shadow, something wrong at the edge of the frame, decayed textures, uneasy off-centre composition, low-key lighting, single cold practical light, desaturated palette with one sickly accent colour, fog
negative_prompt: bright cheerful lighting, cartoon, comedy, clean new surfaces, gore close-up, text, watermark
